name: Any BIC Identifier
definition: Code allocated to a financial or non-financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority, as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".
format: Required format is 6 uppercase letters, then 1 uppercase letter or any of 2-9, then 1 digit or any of A-N P-Z, then optionally 3 uppercase letters or digits

AnyBIC.definition: Only a valid Business identifier code is allowed. Business identifier codes for financial or non-financial institutions are registered by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority in the BIC directory, and consists of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.
